"Just Lose It" is a song by American rapper Eminem from his fifth studio album, Encore (2004).
It was released on September 27, 2004, as the lead single from Encore.
The song caused controversy as its lyrics and music video parodies Michael Jackson, who was being accused of child molestation at the time.
